newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Terms changed on Novartis, Sandoz Capital bonds.
newsitem.headline: Terms changed on Novartis, Sandoz Capital bonds.

text.p: Terms have been changed on Novartis AG's two percent convertible bond due 1998 and Sandoz Capital BVI Ltd's 1-1/4 percent convertible due 2002 that is guaranteed by Novartis, Credit Suisse First Boston said.
The conversion price on the Novartis bond has been reduced to 2,620.35 Swiss francs from 3,143.
The conversion price on the Sandoz Capital bond has been reduced to 4,710.05 Swiss francs from 5,200.
The conversion of bonds into registered shares at the reduced conversion price will be effected as of March 18, 1997.
